in_arabic.name: Gord
in_arabic.long_meaning: Gord هو اسم عربي إسلامي يحمل معنى عميقاً في الثقافة الإسلامية. This name is derived from the Old Persian word 'gord', which means 'mountain'. It is a name that represents strength and resilience, as mountains are known for their enduring nature and ability to withstand the test of time.
